description: Recommendations for all 38 exact PlantVillage-style model labels. Soil advice is general guidance and should be refined using measured pH, NPK, moisture, crop stage and local extension recommendations.

leaf_actions.en: Prune for airflow; remove and dispose of fallen infected leaves. Ask a local extension officer about locally registered preventive fungicides.

Alluvial soil.en: Prioritize drainage and avoid prolonged waterlogging.

Black Soil.en: Maintain even moisture; use mulch without piling it against the trunk.

Clay soil.en: Use compost to improve structure; irrigate at the root zone and avoid waterlogging.

Red soil.en: Use compost/mulch to improve moisture retention; avoid overhead irrigation.

safety_note.en: Image classification is an estimate, not a confirmed diagnosis. Verify symptoms with a qualified local agricultural expert. Use only locally registered products and follow label directions.
